name: BridgeDeck
subtitle: Android TV management from iPhone
description: Native iPhone ADB dashboard with discovery, app management, careful privacy cleanup and guided troubleshooting. Unsigned IPA releases for FlareStore or EmberSign.

apps.name: BridgeDeck
apps.subtitle: Control Android TV without typing ADB commands
apps.localizedDescription: Native iPhone dashboard for ADB app management, approved package cleanup, browser/Home preferences and diagnostics. The Android TV companion advertises discovery but does not bypass ADB authorization.

versions.localizedDescription: Native ADB interface, TV discovery, app manager, recovery-first cleanup and readable errors. Requires authorized ADB over your local network.
versions.changelog: Initial unsigned iPhone prerelease. BridgeDeck TV companion is available separately in EmberTV.

versions.localizedDescription: Native iPhone ADB Toolbox with visible app management, Sony cleanup review, browser/Home/TV app controls, categorized one-tap shell commands and immediate troubleshooting results. Auto-reconnects when returning to the app. Requires authorized ADB on the TV.
versions.changelog:
- First-screen ADB Toolbox: Apps, Clean, Defaults, ADB commands & AI
- Collapsed connection details and auto-dismissed keyboard so navigation stays accessible
- Categorized common ADB commands and immediate results with offline/AI error help
- Optional review and reversible disable for installed third-party apps
- Browser/TV app pickers, Home launcher discovery, and foreground ADB reconnect
- Built using an SDK with Apple Foundation Models support
